organization.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of America
organization.source: Factory Launch research fixture + live site crawl 2026-07-20

signals: America Needs Club Kids — national narrative
7.7 million kids unsupervised after school; ~25 million lack after-school access
Future-ready framing: leaders, scientists, change-makers growing up in Clubs
Youth of the Year / Alumni Hall of Fame — human proof over program catalogs
Outcome data: graduation expectation, post-secondary plans, volunteering, standing up for what is right
CTAs: Find a Club, Give, message a Club Kid — belonging and support, not SaaS signup
research.servicesAreWeakSignal: After-school programs are the vehicle; the story is belonging + future readiness for America’s kids

oib.primaryAudience: Parents, supporters, educators, and community leaders who care whether kids have a place after school
oib.whoTheyAre: A national movement of local Clubs that keep kids future-ready when the school day ends — safe places, caring adults, and peers who believe in them.
oib.mission: Ensure that every young person who enters a Club has the opportunity to thrive, lead, and shape America’s tomorrow.
oib.story: Tomorrow’s leaders are growing up right now — often alone after school. Boys & Girls Clubs open doors so Club Kids become the scientists, advocates, and neighbors the country needs.
oib.whyTheyExist: Millions of kids lack supervised, enriching after-school time. BGCA exists so no child has to face that gap alone.
oib.whoTheyHelp: Kids and teens who need a Club: a safe place, mentors, and a path to graduate, lead, and belong.
oib.whyItMatters: America’s future is decided in the hours after school — who is watching, who is teaching, who is believing.
oib.whatChanges: Kids move from unsupervised hours to belonging, from isolation to leadership, from uncertainty to plans after high school.
differentiators: National scale with local Club belonging
Youth voice centered (Youth of the Year, alumni stories)
Outcome evidence tied to real Club participation
Invitation to community — Find a Club / support a Club Kid — not product trial

brand.headline: America Needs Club Kids
brand.subhead: When kids have a Club, they thrive — and so does the country that raises them.
brand.voice: Warm, urgent about kids, hopeful without hype — community first, never corporate brochure.

member.whereYouAre: Connected to the Club movement that keeps kids future-ready after school.
member.whatNext: Find your nearest Club or deepen support for Club Kids this week.
member.purpose: Give every kid a door that opens toward belonging and leadership.
member.whatSuccessLooksLike: Kids known by name, supervised after school, expecting to graduate and lead.

rationale: Primary verbs are gather, belong, Club, together — Community Builder owns the emotional center.
National stakes language (America Needs Club Kids, unsupervised millions) is Advocate modulation, not Challenger protest.
Proof is people and belonging outcomes, not craft perfection (not Craftsman) or clinical care (not Caregiver).
Services (programs/STEM) are vehicles; story is a generation with a place after school.

storyLens.primaryEmotionalOutcome: Belonging first — “I have a place here” — with dignity that kids’ futures matter nationally
storyLens.visualLanguage: Groups, circles, shared tables; human focus with respectful portrait framing for Advocate tint
storyLens.photographyStyle: Many faces; gatherings; warm ambient light; real Club energy — no stock handshake diversity
storyLens.narrativePacing: Inclusive chorus; story of kids before ask; Current reality beat allowed by Advocate secondary
storyLens.typographyPersonality: Friendly, open display; clear urgent-but-humane body
storyLens.motionPhilosophy: Soft collective reveals; emphatic but not frantic
storyLens.colorPersonality: Deep Club blue as trust ground; warm orange accent for invitation — avoid cold tech SaaS blue grids
storyLens.ctaPhilosophy: Join us / find a Club / stand with Club Kids — belonging and support, not hard close
storyLens.proofStrategy: Member and alumni stories; Youth of the Year; outcome data only when true

creativeDirection.storyInOneSentence: America’s tomorrow is already sitting in Clubs after school — give every kid that door.
creativeDirection.primaryEmotionalObjective: Belonging that feels nationally urgent without becoming fear marketing
creativeDirection.visualMetaphor: An open Club door at golden hour — kids moving from empty afternoon streets into light and recognition
creativeDirection.narrativeArc: Face → gap → promise → change → evidence → invitation

photographyDirection.subject: Club Kids in real after-school moments; mentors beside, never above
photographyDirection.light: Warm late-day interior / golden exterior thresholds
photographyDirection.crop: Editorial, intimate groups; avoid brochure lineup

creativeDirection.typographyPersonality: Bold humanist display for belonging statements; highly readable sans for stakes and proof
creativeDirection.motionPhilosophy: Three motions only: door-threshold fade on Human; slow rise on Impact numbers; soft settle on Invitation

colorStrategy.restraint: Large fields of deep blue or warm paper; one accent per viewport; no rainbow pills

creativeDirection.ctaPhilosophy: Primary ask after Impact: Find a Club. Secondary: support a Club Kid. Never feature-grid CTAs.
antiPatterns: EAHero → About → three feature cards → CTA
Portal product language on public homepage
Equal icon cards for STEM / sports / arts as the story
creativeDirection.swapTestPromise: Without logo or name, still reads as a youth-belonging after-school movement fighting empty afternoons — not a generic nonprofit or SaaS.

questionsAnswered.beat: Human story — Club Kids and the adults who show up
Invitation — Find a Club / stand with them

order.job: Meet the kids the afternoon is for
Name the unsupervised gap without shame
State why Clubs exist for America’s future
Find a Club / support a Club Kid

omitted: Proof as separate scene (folded into Impact stories)

layoutComposer.note: Mapped scenes → editorial compositions. Did not call buildStarterWebsitePuckData. Did not emit EAFeatures×3.

sceneToComposition.composition: Full-bleed threshold photography + brand-level belonging line
Documentary type block; single stark statistic
Full-width mission plane; large type; no cards
Sparse outcome figures as narrative, not metric strip chrome
Single clear ask + secondary support path
